ACQUISITION.title: DAU (Defense Acquisition University)
ACQUISITION.description: DAU provides a global learning environment to develop qualified acquisition, requirements and contingency professionals who deliver and sustain effective and affordable warfighting capabilities. Individuals with a current affiliation with the United States government qualify to participate in training offered by DAU. Non-DoD federal agency and defense industry employees (contractors) may attend DAU courses at no cost on a space-available basis.

ACQUISITION.title: EPO (Electronic Project Order)
ACQUISITION.description: The Electronic Project Order (EPO) web-based application is an Air Combat Command (ACC) domain allowing ACC HQ Staff, Test Center, and Test Organization personnel to track multiple Fiscal Year weapon systems test execution and support activities. Point of Contact: Gregory J. Diamontopulus, ACC/A5TT, DSN 574-1088, gregory.diamontopulos.1@us.af.mil

ACQUISITION.title: EZ Source Electronic Source Selection Tool [.mil/CAC Required]
ACQUISITION.description: The EZ Source electronic source selection tool is a web-based workflow application that facilitates the creation, organization, and communication of sensitive, unclassified, competitive source selection documentation used in the source selection evaluation process. The EZ Source electronic source selection tool is designed for best value, negotiated, competitive acquisitions under FAR Part 15. Additional information is available on AF Contracting Central. Since EZ Source is the AF directed tool for source selections of $100 million or greater or high visibility programs, the program management of EZ Source has been transferred to AFLCMC/GBB. AFLCMC/GBB provides support and training on the use of the tool. A processed DD Form 2875 and active source selection team are required to access the application. Users must select their EMAIL certificate to access the site.

ACQUISITION.title: FedMall
ACQUISITION.description: FedMall, formerly DOD eMALL, functions as an online focal point for DOD customers seeking to acquire off-the-shelf, finished goods from the commercial marketplace.

ACQUISITION.title: IDECS (Integrated Budget Documentation and Execution System)
ACQUISITION.description: IDECS automates the preparation, validation, analysis, and publication of budget documentation for Air Force Aircraft Procurement, Missile Procurement, Procurement of Ammunition, Other Procurement, and Research, Development, Test and Evaluation (RDT&E) appropriations. To report a problem with IDECS or post a question to the IDECS Team, please send an email here.

ACQUISITION.title: MPM (Modernization Process Model)
ACQUISITION.description: The Air Force Modernization Process Model (MPM) provides the documented current state process in an integrated fashion. The MPM is a compilation of policy, instructions, and guidance that acts as the Gold Standard for persons involved in the Acquisition Process.

ACQUISITION.title: PMRT (Project Management Resource Tool)
ACQUISITION.description: Project Management Resource Tools (PMRT) is a suite of enterprise applications designed to support a number of key facets of program and financial management, acquisition reporting and supervisory oversight. The primary PMRT applications are Program Data Alignment Application (PDAA), Comprehensive Cost and Requirement System (CCaR™), Acquisition Tracker (Acq Tracker), Strategic Resource Management (SRM), Undefinitized Contract Actions (UCA) and Unpriced Change Orders (UCO) Tracker, Express Contract Action Report System (ECARS), Requests for Equitable Adjustments (REA) and Claims Tracker (REACT), and PMRT Enterprise Analytics (EA).

ACQUISITION.title: SMT (Strategic Management Tool)
ACQUISITION.description: The Strategic Management Tool (SMT) application allows the services community to identify and approve requirements that will be satisfied by acquiring contracted services and track service programs and their associated contracts. SMT helps to streamline the management and reporting of the services community.

ACQUISITION.title: Web CCaR (Web Comprehensive Cost and Requirements)
ACQUISITION.description: The Comprehensive Cost and Requirement (CCaR™) System is an enterprise program and financial management system that provides organizations with a common sense, hierarchical approach to managing requirements and budgets, and execution data. The system allows program and financial managers to define program requirements, formulate budgets, forecast program execution and track execution of funds – all in one place. In addition to integrating the organization’s internal processes, CCaR™ also interfaces with many of the external systems currently used in the systems acquisition process. With CCaR™, users are seamlessly integrated into official accounting systems, contracting systems and many other external systems. From requirements definition, documentation and coordination, to fully detailed execution forecasting, to funds execution, to the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process, CCaR™ supports the entire life cycle of program and financial management activities in an organization.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: Air Force Be Ready
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: Everyone should have a plan. Disasters come in many forms; explosions, hurricanes, tornadoes, and others. Being prepared can reduce fear, anxiety, and losses that accompany these disasters. Individuals, families, and communities should know what to do in the event of a fire and where to seek shelter during a tornado. Knowing what to expect and how to prepare makes any crisis more manageable. Take three simple steps to preparing today: Get a Kit, Make a Plan, and Be Prepared. A Be Ready mobile application is also available on the site.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: Air Force Housing
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: Airmen and their families now have an online resource to help them learn about housing options available at their new duty station. The Air Force Housing website provides information on family and unaccompanied housing available at Air Force installations world-wide. It also provides information on local communities near Air Force installations, school district information, local weather and other useful resources that will help Airmen and their families become familiar with their new homes.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: APIMS (Air Program Information Management System)
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: APIMS is the Air Force information system for air quality permit management, air emission inventory, and air emission reporting.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: BaS&E - Base Support & Expeditionary Planning System
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: BaS&E is a versatile, Cloud Based application used as a repository of airfield information for sites around the world with military interests. This information feeds the Deliberate and Crisis Action Planning tool suit used by commanders at all levels to decide/’create Course of Actions (CoA) on both NIPR and SIPR. The system aids in the bed-down of equipment and personnel (Ex: Aircraft parking and maintenance, feeding and housing personnel, building information, and much more). Offers limiting factor identification, and facilitates force tailoring decisions. BaS&E captures all aspects of a site/location such as flight line, housing, and transportation to determine which location can best support incoming forces based on tasking.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: BaS&E Training - Base Support & Expeditionary Planning System (Training)
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: The Training Instance resides in the NIPRNET and duplicates the functionality of the companion Production instance. The purpose of this instance is to allow BaS&E users to train and test actions in the application without having an effect on live data.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: ECARS (Employee-vehicle Certification And Reporting System)
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: ECARS is part of the Air Force Vehicle Self-Certification Program, which brings the Air Force in compliance with the Clean Air Act, Section 118d. This statute requires all federal (both military and civilian) employees to meet the Vehicle Inspection and Maintenance (I/M) Program requirements where the member is employed. Federal employees, both military and civilian, may receive emails from no-reply@apims.af.mil titled "Action Required: vehicle emission testing self-certification is due within 30 days". Upon receiving the email, the employees will log on to the ECARS website and enter the year, make and model of the vehicle.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: eDASH
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: eDASH is the Air Force's one-stop online communication resource that facilitates effective environmental management by providing standard procedures, performance metrics, and functional tools for more efficient information exchange to meet the mission of the Air Force at all levels. For help please click here to submit a ticket.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: EESOH-MIS (Enterprise Environmental Safety and Occupational Health-Management Information System)
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: EESOH-MIS will provide an effective method for the collection, management, and on-line availability of environmental, safety, occupational health and industrial hygiene information to support the cradle to grave tracking of ESOH issues. Upon completion, EESOH-MIS will provide a corporate system tying together three transactional systems through the use of a common subscriber data, direct interfaces, and consolidation of data in an EESOH data repository. EESOH-MIS will be a comprehensive, automated information system for assembling, comparing, using, evaluating, and storing information relating to: Environmental and civil engineering, baseline air emission inventory, workplace environmental monitoring, engineering control, material and usage, regulatory compliance and work practice procedures, personnel exposures to occupational hazards/material, pollution prevention, and hazardous waste.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: EESOH-MIS Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Search
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: EESOH-MIS manages Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and the associated chemical data for hazardous material used Air Force-wide to support environmental, safety, and occupational health (ESOH) reporting to assess the impacts and hazards of AF processes. The Hazard Communication Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200) requires the data be "readily accessible" to all employees. Points of Contact: EESOH Help Desk email: helpdesk@eesohsupport.com; Phone: 1-866-643-6541.

CIVIL ENGINEER.title: VEMO (Virtual Environmental Management Office)
CIVIL ENGINEER.description: The Virtual Environmental Management Office (VEMO), leverages SharePoint capabilities to become the Air National Guard's (ANG) electronic Environmental Management System (EMS) Manual. VEMO allows the ANG to communicate and implement the ISO 14001 standard, and fulfill Executive Orders and other requirements. VEMO provides the tools necessary to demonstrate conformance and enhance the auditability of the entire system. The ANG EMS is implemented at the organizational level (ANG Readiness Center), and cascades down to our multiple ANG bases, GSUs, and in some instances ANG tenants on other installations across the United States and territories.

COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.title: AFDS (Air Force Directory Services)
COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: AFDS is the system used to effectively manage access control, identity management, and security threats while simplifying security management. It serves as the single authoritative source for identity data used by networks and applications, reducing redundancy of directory services currently deployed in the AF. AFDS is the key enabler required for single sign-on, smart card login, PKI data exchange, AF white pages/GAL, account provisioning, medium assurance messaging, GCSS-AF/IF, and AF Portal initiatives. POC: AFLCMC/HIZB AFDS, DSN 596-6060, 754.don.afds@us.af.mil.

COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.title: AFRIMS (AF Records Information Management System)
COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: Air Force Records Information Management System (AFRIMS) is the mandatory, AF-wide system that provides AF Records Managers, at all levels of organization, an online, real-time system to manage and prepare file plans and associated records management products. AFRIMS also provides real-time access and management of the USAF Records Disposition Schedule (RDS). Contact Information: AFRIMS Helpdesk 478-222-8241 or AFLCMC.GBB.WP-AFRIMS-SUPPORT@us.af.mil

COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.title: Air Force White Pages [.mil]
COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: The Air Force White Pages is a service provided by Air Force Directory Services (AFDS). Individuals may use the white pages to search for individuals in the Air Force by first name, last name, rank and/or location. White pages data comes from the AF Global Address List (GAL). The AFDS program office may be contacted at DSN: 596-6060, Commercial: (334) 416-6060, Fax: (334) 416-4668 or Email:754.don.afds@us.af.mil

COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.title: APAN - All Partners Access Network
COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: The All Partners Access Network (APAN) is the premier unclassified information sharing and collaboration enterprise for the United States Department of Defense (DOD). APAN provides the DOD and mission partners community spaces and collaborative tools to leverage information to effectively plan, train and respond to meet their business requirements and mission objectives. APAN makes these tools available over the open internet so individuals and organizations who do not have access to traditional DOD systems and networks can participate in information sharing and collaborative events.

COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: CIPS automates the planning process at the Base, MAJCOM, and Air Force levels. COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: The gcss-af.com website provides a hub for the Service Integration and Management of the GCSS-AF Program. It also provides various users much current information, process tools (Change Management, Release Management, Incident Management), and communicative tools to meet their specific GCSS-AF program needs. Typical users would include: GCSS-AF application developers and integrators Prospective GCSS-AF team members Air Force members in general GCSS-AF subcontractors and vendors Links to specific pages within the .com site: Change Requests - used to track new requirements and changes to the GCSS-AF infrastructure Deficiency Report System - used to track problems with delivered GCSS-AF infrastructure capability RSO Activity Handler - check reduced sign on (RSO) activities and submit request for a new RSO application Watch Item Tracker (WIT) - used to track potential problems with delivered GCSS-AF infrastructure If the above link is grayed out: And you already have a GCSS-AF.com account, please email the GCSS-AF.com Website Administrator to request access. COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.title: GDS (Global Directory Service)
COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: The Global Directory Service (GDS) is an effort to provide an enterprise wide directory service for DoD. GDS offers a DoD-wide search capability for information regarding DoD personnel (name, telephone number, e-mail address, and key encipherment certificate). Although GDS currently serves as a locator service for DoD personnel, its capability will be expanded, providing the infrastructure needed for authorized users and applications to find people, components, and applications regardless of their location. For more information about GDS, please contact the GDS Project Management Office (PMO) at GDS@ncr.disa.mil.

COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.title: NIPRGPT
COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: NIPRGPT is a Department of the Air Force (DAF) Generative AI (GenAI) platform that aims to enhance human-machine teaming, identify the specific use of GenAI, and build Airmen and Guardians' technical competencies. It is currently in its first phase of formal testing and provides users with access to open-source GenAI models to explore the technology. NIPRGPT began as a prototype application in late 2023 and has since grown significantly. It has a strategic role in the DAF's digital modernization strategy, enabling human-machine teaming and allowing the DAF to gauge the demand for AI tools across its workforce. User feedback is central to NIPRGPT's development, and active user participation is encouraged to help shape future commercial and enterprise solutions.

COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.title: SSL - Software Sharing Library
COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: The Software Sharing Library (SSL) is a web-based application used to provide software solutions to the entire Combat Air Forces (CAF) through the AF Portal. As a central repository, users from the field with access to the internet will be able to access any solution developed or used within the CAF. The ACC CSS will host the SSL, while each major command or host agency will maintain their portion of the repository using a special client, giving them full maintenance capabilities.Contact Information: Carolyn Pender, DSN 574-6589

COMMUNICATIONS / INFORMATION.description: The Warehouse Management System (WMS) 2.2 is an Air Force Departmental Publishing Office (AFDPO) web-based application which provides an interface for publishing customers to view, access and order electronic and physical products from one source. Please select the email certificate on your CAC to access the site. For technical support and/or any questions regarding WMS products and services, please contact the e-Publishing Service Help Desk, DSN 754-2438, comm 202-404-2438, usaf.pentagon.saf-aa.mbx.afdpo-e-publishing-customer-svc@mail.mil.

CONTRACTING.title: CFT (Contract Field Team)
CONTRACTING.description: Contract Field Team (CFT) application is used to manage the CFT contract funding levels, performance data, government oversight, and program management. CFT supports the Contract Field Team's Program Office, DCMA, and the CFT field users worldwide. A DD Form 2875 must be filled out and submitted in order to gain access to the system. Instructions and availability of the requisite form can be found at the CFT Home Page and you can request access to the application by clicking the "Request Access" button at the bottom of the page. If you experience any problems, contact: Chad Medford DSN 884-0455, Comm (405) 734-0455, mailto:chad.medford.1@us.af.mil. To report issues with application availability, please contact the Tinker Helpdesk at 72cs.scb.help@us.af.mil or DSN 884-HELP.

CONTRACTING.title: SSAT-S - Strategic Sourcing Analysis Tool - Sustainment
CONTRACTING.description: The Strategic Sourcing Analysis Tool - Sustainment (SSAT-S) is a unique data mining and analysis tool that resides within the Global Combat Support System - Air Force (GCSS-AF) Data Services data warehouse. SSAT-S is not a stand-alone Command system, legacy replacement, or data entry point, but rather a business intelligence tool that provides the capability to answer key strategic sourcing business questions. SSAT-S provides this capability by making available select historical AF spend and forecasted requirements data for replenishment spares (buys) and depot repair at the stock number level. SSAT-S achieves this by successfully integrating previously disparate data from over a dozen AF and Federal government systems across the contracting, supply, and maintenance domains. SSAT-S is currently sponsored and maintained by HQ AFMC/PKT. All users are required to have GCSS-AF Data Services production and AF Portal accounts. For SSAT-S access, please contact the SSAT-S Help Desk afmc.a4.ssats.team@wpafb.af.mil or visit https://ssat.wpafb.af.mil/

FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT.description: The mission of DFAS is to "Direct, approve and perform finance and accounting activities for DoD". Our mission is about the customer. FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT.description: eFinance Workspace is the store front to complete a variety of financial processes and documents. The system also allows Active Duty AF, AF Reserve, and AF Civilian members to complete non-DTS TDY vouchers and Active Duty AF members with some select Military Pay transactions. For access, contact Tim Melville at DSN 487-8811 or 210-652-4266, Email: timothy.melville.1@us.af.mil.

FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT.title: TSP (Thrift Savings Plan)
FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT.description: The Thrift Savings Plan (TSP) is a retirement savings and investment plan for Federal employees and members of the uniformed services, including the Ready Reserve. It was established by Congress in the Federal Employees' Retirement System Act of 1986 and offers the same types of savings and tax benefits that many private corporations offer their employees under 401(k) plans. The TSP is a defined contribution plan, meaning that the retirement income you receive from your TSP account will depend on how much you (and your agency, if you are eligible to receive agency contributions) put into your account during your working years and the earnings accumulated over that time.

FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT.title: WAWF (Wide Area Workflow) [.mil/.com]
FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT.description: WAWF is an E-commerce business solution for the Department of Defense and Defense Contractors. It is an integration tool and technical approach for reducing unmatched disbursements in the DoD receipt, acceptance, entitlement, and payment process through sharing of data and electronic documents. This interactive, web-based application allows users to generate, capture, and process receipt and payment-related documentation. Additional information on WAWF may be found here.

GENERAL.title: Crowd Vector

GAIN is SAF/MG’s front-end platform for ingesting and tracking innovation initiatives across the Department of the Air Force.

GENERAL.title: DAF MWR Virtual Library
GENERAL.description: The DAF Virtual Library website is the central access point to resources to support professional and personal development. Eligible users can access resources including eBooks, audiobooks, newspapers, magazines, and more using their DoD ID and DOB or by registering for a library account at an MWR installation library. GENERAL.title: FEDLOG® (Federal Logistics)
GENERAL.description: Federal Logistics (FEDLOG®) provides the ability to access Federal Logistics Information System (FLIS) data where the user may not have persistent internet connectivity. FED LOG provides essential information about supply items to include the National Stock Number (NSN), the Approved Item Name, Manufacturers and Distributors information (to include Part Numbers), Freight Data, Hazardous Materiel Indicators, Interchangeable and Substitutable data, Acquisition Advice Code (AAC) and Unit Price, Physical and Performance Characteristics along with service specific management data. FED LOG is available as a free downloadable product and is available in ‘Complete’ or ‘Lite’ versions. The “Lite” version is about half the size of the complete version, but does not contain Characteristics, CAGE or History data. FEDLOG® data is Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and it is releasable to NATO and NATO Sponsored Countries, Federal and Civilian Agencies, Government contractors and the Department of Defense.

GENERAL.title: FEDLOG® Lite (Federal Logistics)
GENERAL.description: Federal Logistics (FEDLOG®) provides the ability to access Federal Logistics Information System (FLIS) data where the user may not have persistent internet connectivity. FEDLOG® provides essential information about supply items to include the National Stock Number (NSN), the Approved Item Name, Manufacturers and Distributors information (to include Part Numbers), Freight Data, Hazardous Materiel Indicators, Interchangeable and Substitutable data, Acquisition Advice Code (AAC) and Unit Price, Physical and Performance Characteristics along with service specific management data. FEDLOG® is available as a free downloadable product and is available in ‘Complete’ or ‘Lite’ versions. The “Lite” version is about half the size of the complete version, but does not contain Characteristics, CAGE or History data. FEDLOG® data is Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and it is releasable to NATO and NATO Sponsored Countries, Federal and Civilian Agencies, Government contractors and the Department of Defense.

GENERAL.title: FES-IMS (Fire and Emergency Services - Information Management System)
GENERAL.description: The Fire and Emergency Services - Information Management System (FES-IMS) is designed to support base level and higher Headquarters Civil Engineer (CE) fire department functions in day-to-day operations for emergency dispatch and data management. FES-IMS provides direct Civil Engineer information management support to active Air Force units, the Air National Guard, and the Air Force Reserve, during peace and war times, at fixed main bases. Additionally, the system is currently being used at AOR locations in support of their missions. FES-IMS functions as an interoperable, user-friendly system providing information that expedites effective emergency response support during normal and contingency operations. FES-IMS provides resource tracking and critical decision-making in the management of emergency fire services, and is critical for National Fire Incident Reporting System (NFIRS) incident response tracking.

HEALTH SERVICES.description: IAW DoD 6025.18-R, DoD Health Information Privacy Regulation (24 Jan 03), Specialized Government Functions provision, to assure the proper execution of the military mission and AFI 41-210, Tricare Operations and Patient Administration Functions, Section 6E, the Medical Group must have verification of those personnel to receive protected health information (PHI) on the behalf of the Commander. PHI may be disclosed to those Armed Forces personnel for activities deemed necessary by appropriate Military Command Authorities (MCA) to assure the proper execution of the military mission. The DoD and AFI allows Commanders to designate appropriate senior staff, Unit Health Monitor(s), Unit Deployment Manager(s) as "Commander Designees" for the purpose of receiving PHI on members under the Military Command Authority provisions of the HIPAA Privacy Rule. The use of RAMMIS-W is mandatory for AF organizations in accordance with Air Force Instruction (AFI) 40-201, Radioactive Materials (RAM) Management, for maintaining a current repository for managing, inventorying and tracking the transfer of all generally licensed devices (GLDs) in the USAF. LOGISTICS READINESS.title: ACPINS (Automated Computer Program Identification Number System)
LOGISTICS READINESS.description: The Air Force ACPINS system provides a standardized automated information system (AIS) to number, manage, catalog, requisition and track Mission Critical Software (MCS) for National Security Systems (NSS), which supports combat weapons systems in the Air Force inventory. The ACPINS functionality is being subsumed by the ETIMS application beginning in the ETIMS Release 01.03. This release has undergone the initial User Evaluation Test and is on schedule to be put into Production on 28 February 2019. The data that is currently in the ACPINS database will be migrated into the ETIMS database as part of the installation process. The ACPINS data has to be captured, physically moved and then imported into ETIMS. To facilitate this migration the last day for ACPINS operation will be Thursday 14 February 2019. Beginning 15 February 2019 all users of ACPINS will be locked out of the system while the data is prepared for migration. NO ACPINS/CPIN requests will be processed during this time.

LOGISTICS READINESS.title: CSWS DE (Contractor Supported Weapon Systems Data Exchange) (WPAFB) [.mil/.com]

The CSWS DE will record actual usage and failure data from the beginning of the acquisition process. The data will then be used to make demand-based procurements and will eliminate disconnects between faulty spares computation logic, budget estimates, and actual executable requirements. LOGISTICS READINESS.title: ISMT (The Information Systems Management Tool) [.mil/.com]
LOGISTICS READINESS.description: The Information Systems Management Tool (ISMT) is a configuration and requirements management tracking and software workload management system to support logistics system systems engineering life-cycle functions. The system supports the entire software life cycle from requirements inception, through deployment and internal systems engineering activities. ISMT provides system functional owners, program managers, developers, testers, configuration managers and end users a means to initiate, vet, document, and submit IT system current services (sustainment) and modernization change requests into the approval process and monitor approved requests until implementation. ISMT is the standard management tool for the AF Logistics IT Change Control Process for all systems in the Logistics Mission Areas and used by other functional area customers. Its dynamic query engine and custom report generator provide numerous options for gathering metrics and the system contains an integrated action tracking capability as well. ISMT primarily supports logistics systems but its IT requirements management capability can be used by any functional area. ISMT is a GOTS system, maintained by on-site contractors with program management oversight provided by AFLCMC/GBM and AFMC/A4N is the functional owner. To apply for an account, please contact the program office via e-mail or telephone call to Brad Black at DSN 312-787-0324.

LOGISTICS READINESS.title: JEDMICS (Joint Engineering Data Management Information Control System)
LOGISTICS READINESS.description: The Joint Engineering Data Management Information and Control System (JEDMICS) is a DoD standard engineering data management and repository system. A total of twenty-two Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine and DLA sites currently use JEDMICS to manage over 80 million engineering drawings for more than 36,000 users. Additionally, several external logistic systems depend on the JEDMICS application interface to obtain engineering drawing data. JEDMICS capabilities support DOD logistics business functions, such as maintenance, repair, procurement and re-engineering by providing worldwide, on-demand access to digital engineering drawings and associated data.

LOGISTICS READINESS.title: LOGMOD - Logistics Module
LOGISTICS READINESS.description: LOGMOD provides automated capability to schedule, monitor and control movement of cargo and personnel in support of contingency operations. It provides reports and real-time data to key personnel to include Combatant Commanders. Active Air Force, Air Force Reserve, Air National Guard and Space Force units use LOGMOD at base level for development, sustainment and execution of deployment packages, at the MAJCOM level for review and validation of unit data, and at the Air Staff for development of reports for the Joints Staff. LOGMOD is the primary system for base users to perform planning, development, sustainment and execution of Unit Type Codes (UTCs) for exercises, AEFs, and contingencies.

PRPS performs competition screening and generates electronic Purchase Requests (PRs), Military Interdepartmental Purchase Requests (MIPRs), and Delivery Order Requests (DORs) including the appropriate attachments. LOGISTICS READINESS.title: WSMIS REALM - Requirements/Execution Availability Logistics Module [.mil/.com]
LOGISTICS READINESS.description: The Requirements/Execution Availability Logistics Module (REALM) is a mission-critical application that provides the basis for development of the Readiness Spares Packages (RSPs) that support wartime deployment of Air Force (AF) weapon systems worldwide. REALM is the corporate database for Mobility Readiness Spares Packages (MRSP), In-place Readiness Spares Packages (IRSP), and High Priority Mission Support Kits (HPMSK) that support weapon system squadron deployments in wartime. REALM facilitates the exchange of RSP and HPMSK information among numerous AF commands and other organizations throughout the course of the annual RSP review cycle. REALM supports reviews of the range of items in RSPs and HPMSKs, and applies demand rates based on real-world data and projected combat flying hours to the spares packages for accurate requirements computations. REALM ultimately provides approved RSP fiscal year spares requirements to numerous other data systems for combat capability assessment, requisitioning, budgeting, and projecting requirements. REALM provides the primary application for the AF Major Commands (MAJCOMs) and Air Logistics Centers (ALCs), in support of the RSP contingency and buy (third-year forecast) annual review cycle. Currently, REALM computes and manages $5 billion in gross spares requirements annually.This application uses data feeds from the following data systems: D002A, D035T, D040, D043, D046, D087C, D087W, D200A, and Q310. To request access, contact Brent Maxwell at brent.maxwell.2@us.af.mil, DSN 787-5929, Commercial (937) 257-5929.

MAINTENANCE.title: DRILS/G200 (Defense Repair Information Logistics System) [.mil/.com]
MAINTENANCE.description: G200 DRILS is a web based system for collection and reporting of unclassified serialized maintenance data for land, air, and space systems that supports flexible sustainment analysis and bad actor identification. It accumulates, validates, processes, stores, and makes accessible to Air Force data consumers the data necessary to identify greatest return on investment improvement areas within high value systems. Worldwide users connect to DRILS at Ogden ALC via the NIPRNET from desktop PCs and wireless laptops utilizing web browsers from the point-of-maintenance. Field units at home and deployed base locations as well as depot facilities, and repair contractors access the central OLTP system, providing worldwide visibility of system repair history.

MAINTENANCE.title: DSOR AMS (Depot Source of Repair Automated Management System)
MAINTENANCE.description: The DSOR AMS is a web based decision management support tool providing an audit trail of DSOR decisions throughout a system’s lifecycle. The DSOR AMS is the authoritative source for all unclassified DSOR activities assisting the Product Support Manager (PSM) in completion of the associated processes including depot activations, periodic reviews and Depot Maintenance Inter Service Agreement (DMISAs).

MAINTENANCE.title: EMAP (Eagle Modification Action Plan) [.mil/.com]
MAINTENANCE.description: EMAP is the lead command standard system to manage the F-15 aircraft fleet, its configuration and status, from aircraft initial delivery through retirement. EMAP is a web-based DOD certified software system that has met all DOD and Air Force network and security requirements. EMAP provides planned and actual F-15 PDM modification and depot repair program information for global F-15 decision-makers, support staff, field units and qualified contractors. EMAP provides F-15 aircraft inventory management and automated scheduling of aircraft PDM, depot repair and modifications. The automated what if tools that simplify modification scheduling and integration are unique to EMAP and greatly speed scheduling and improve accuracy and effectiveness. EMAP ARTS (AMARG Resource Tracking System) provides complete tools for managing the retired AMARG fleet. Parts management research to the tail number is provided including detailed parts search and parts inventory removed and available. ARTS also provides best candidate selection for aircraft regeneration and migration. Pictures are also available to provide the all important reality check on aircraft condition. REMIS and CEMS data is imported to insure the system has the latest aircraft and TCTO information. EMAP is managed by the F-15 Program Office (830 ACSG). MAINTENANCE.title: EMOC - Enhanced Maintenance Operations Center [.mil/.com]
MAINTENANCE.description: The EMOC system is the United States Air Force's (USAF) standard automated system in support of the Maintenance Operations Center (MOC) and replaces all other base-level stand-alone systems IAW AFI 21-101, para 6.2.2. EMOC automates key functions within the MOC and replaces the functionality of the old backlit grease boards with today's technology using object-oriented visual displays. The primary users of this system are MOC personnel. Any personnel directly involved in base-level management of aircraft, aircraft status determination and reporting, aircraft movement and location, sortie and maintenance production, execution of the flying and maintenance schedules, or any other personnel that requires access to the EMOC database in the performance of their official duties may have viewing privileges. The EMOC system supports activities at USAF worldwide operating bases, including Air National Guard and AF Reserve sites. To gain Updater or Viewer access to this application, contact your base level EMOC Administrator in the Maintenance MOC section. MAINTENANCE.title: J-RAMS (Joint Reliability Availability Management System) [.mil/.com]
MAINTENANCE.description: The Joint Reliability Availability Management System (J-RAMS) is an integrated analysis system that provides a growing suite of proactive and predictive analysis tools and actionable reports to aid Air Force personnel with decision support as it relates to aircraft reliability, availability, and aircraft life-cycle management. The system provides the equipment, system, and aircraft managers with effective decision support as they are faced with increasingly limited resources and increasingly broad mission responsibilities. The system meets a primary logistics management objective: To assess the status of aircraft and aircraft equipment items using timely and meaningful operational and logistics support data. J-RAMS is capable of supporting all AF weapon systems through coordination with the Application Owner and can provide tailored analysis environments, e.g. the A-10 Weapon System Management Environment (AWSME).

MAINTENANCE.title: PAMS (Precision Measurement Equipment Laboratory (PMEL) Automated  Management System) [.mil/.com]
MAINTENANCE.description: The PMEL Automated Management System (PAMS) provides the ability to document Maintenance Data Documentation (MDD) performed by active duty, Federal Service, and contractor metrologists upon Test, Measurement, and Diagnostic Equipment (TMDE) serviced in the local Precision Measurement Equipment Laboratory (PMEL). The information thus collected is used by AFMETCAL Detachment 1 to determine TMDE calibration intervals based on actions taken documented throughout the entire AFMETCAL program. The MDD data is used locally to provide management visibility of the status of the TMDE fleet. PAMS provides subordinate programs to implement functions required by T.O. 00-20-14 pertaining to the AFMETCAL Quality Program (QP), and integrates the QP seamlessly into program operations at all levels.

MANPOWER.title: ARIS (Automated Readiness Information System)
MANPOWER.description: The Automated Readiness Information System (ARIS) supports base level and higher Headquarters Civil Engineering (CE) functions in day-to-day operations to prepare for deployment and maintain a high rate of Unit Type Code (UTC) readiness. ARIS is a management tool for advocating and reporting resources supporting CE, Security Forces and Services for Active Air Force, Air National Guard, and Air Force Reserve during peace and war times. ARIS functions as an interoperable, user-friendly system providing information that expedites effective readiness response and reporting during normal and contingency operations. ARIS provides resource tacking and critical decision-making in the management of readiness, and is a critical component of AF readiness.

Additional information is available in Air Force Guidance Memorandum 2014-38-01, Airmen Powered by Innovation.

MUNITIONS.title: AMMO & AMST - Global Ammunition Control Point (GACP)  [.mil/.com]
MUNITIONS.description: The Global Ammunition Control Point (GACP) is the Centralized Management Function for all conventional munitions activities. The GACP provides "reach back" capability for both the Air Force and Joint munitions community. The GACP will perform four primary roles of munitions management: planning, operations, execution and sustainment. Application Owner Name: Customer Support DSN: 777-2666 Comm: 801-777-2666 Email: 505CBSS.GACP.CONUSCELL@us.af.mil.

MUNITIONS.title: RAM/TMRS (Reliability Asset Monitoring & Tactical Munitions Reporting System) [.mil/.com]
MUNITIONS.description: The Reliability Asset Monitoring & Tactical Munitions Reporting System office (AFLCMC/EBRER ) provides a comprehensive enterprise database management program used for tracking and reporting data about munitions and components. To gain access, please contact Customer Support (DSN 472-4632/472-4635) or email the RAM/TMRS Account Request (DD2875) to: tmrs@us.af.mil.

MUNITIONS.title: TICMS - Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System [.mil only]
MUNITIONS.description: The Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System (TICMS) is the AF’s single application for worldwide conventional munitions configuration management, capability analysis, and combat support. TICMS has consolidated all CAS functionality as the AF’s Class V accountable property system of record and will eventually subsume Ammo-Web, AMST, RAM/TMRS, IMDB, and Munitions Command and Control systems. As a National Security System, TICMS is an integral part of a weapons systems per NIST SP 800-59, section A.1.4. The munitions systems (all-up-rounds and components) managed in TICMS are integrated with other weapons systems to provide direct warfighter capabilities to combatant commanders. Application Owner Helpdesk URL : https://usafammo.cce.af.mil/oms/saml/SSO Comm : 801-777-2666 (AMMO), 801-775 2666 (AMMO) Name : Customer Relationship Management (CRM) System DSN : 777-2666 (AMMO), 775-2666 (AMMO)

MUNITIONS.title: TICMS - Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System Training System
MUNITIONS.description: Training System for Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System. The Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System (TICMS) is the AF's single application for worldwide conventional application for worldwide conventional munitions configuration management, capability analysis and combat support. Providing real-time munitions management and accountability at each level of combat execution from the unit to the JCS, TICMS captures/records field-level transactions including movements, expenditures, serviceability, etc., and allows all command echelons the ability to query, extract, and analyze current and projected inventory/requirements for strategic, operational, and tactical planning and execution. TICMS assesses performance levels of munitions and predicts future reliability standards for AF Precision-Guided Munition weapons systems (including all-up-rounds and unassembled components). Application Owner Helpdesk URL : https://ammo.sso.cce.af.mil/wm/CRM2/NewRequest.aspx Comm : 801-777-2666 (AMMO), 801-775 2666 (AMMO) Name : Customer Relationship Management (CRM) System DSN : 777-2666 (AMMO), 775-2666 (AMMO)

OPERATIONS.title: AFW-WEBS (Air Force Weather-Web Services)
OPERATIONS.description: AFW-WEBS (Air Force Weather Web Services for AF Portal Users) is a suite of interactive web applications that provide meteorological support to DoD operations worldwide. AFW-WEBS is intended to provide a capability not currently provided by other web pages. AFW-WEBS moves away from viewing data as static images in predefined windows, to providing users full control over the AOI, zoom level, and background, and allows users to overlay combinations of data while zooming in to any desired resolution. An AFW-WEBS account is required in order to use AFW-WEBS. To request an account register here.

OPERATIONS.title: APACS (Aircraft and Personnel Automated Clearance System)
OPERATIONS.description: APACS is a web-based tool designed to aid Department of Defense aircraft mission planners and operators, and DoD travelers on official business (and in some cases leave) overseas in meeting the clearance requirements outlined in the DoD Foreign Clearance Guide. APACS automates the process of requesting and approving diplomatic and personnel clearances via a common, centralized, and secure database.

OPERATIONS.title: ARMS - Aviation Resource Management System Aircrew Summary
OPERATIONS.description: The Aviation Resource Management System (ARMS) Aircrew Summary provides USAF, ANG, and AFRC aircrew/parachutist members an online means to view several individual reports displaying aircrew training, flying hour, and jump activities.

OPERATIONS.title: Center Ops Online (COOL) - Edwards

COOL provides aircrew with an environment to take tests, sign-off FCIFs, and check their currency status. OPERATIONS.title: MPC (Mission Planning Central)

PERSONNEL.title: AFPAAS (Air Force Personnel Accountability and Assessment System)
PERSONNEL.description: AFPAAS standardizes a method for the Air Force to account, assess, manage, and monitor the recovery and reconstitution process for personnel and their families affected and/or scattered by a wide-spread catastrophic event. The AFPAAS provides valuable information to all levels of the Air Force chain of command, allowing commanders to make strategic decisions which facilitate a return to stability. AFPAAS allows Air Force Personnel to do the following: Report Accounting Status Update Contact/Location information Complete Needs Assessment View Reference Information If you have problems accessing AFPAAS, please send an email for assistance.

PERSONNEL.description: The Air Force Force Generation (AFFORGEN) Connect provides a single access point for all unclassified AF readiness and deployment preparation/execution information. It allows commanders and their designated delegates to manage, monitor, report, and assess their readiness. PERSONNEL.title: AMS (Assignment Management System)
PERSONNEL.description: Description: AMS, Assignment Management System, is an online program used for assignment preferences and career management for officer and enlisted Airmen. AMS also contains the EQUAL-Plus listings which are updated on a weekly basis and are arranged by grade and AFSC.

PERSONNEL.title: AROWS (Air National Guard Reserve Order Writing System)
PERSONNEL.description: Short Description: The Air National Guard Reserve Order Writing System (AROWS) is a web based information system that supports Air National Guard operations and training missions. It is used to 1) generate call to active duty and change of station orders; 2) electronically certify duty performance for active duty orders; 3) generate group inactive duty drill rosters; 4) electronically certify duty performance for group inactive duty; 5) schedule individual inactive duty; and 6) electronically certify duty performance for individual inactive duty. Access the AROWS SharePoint here.

PERSONNEL.title: ATMT (ARCNet Training Management Toolset)
PERSONNEL.description: ATMT is a new toolset that contains a series of robust training and tracking tools for Air Reserve Component units. The tools are permission and role-based, and are available for individual unit members as well as for training managers and unit leadership. Unit members can not only review their ancillary training summary via the "My Training Details" page, they can log credit for any training accomplished via Computer-Based Training (CBT) modules, and if on a .mil network members can also access the Advanced Distributed Learning Service (ADLS) login page directly from ARCNet. Additionally, members can have any of the 20 courses that write to ADLS update to ADLS with a completion within 24 hours of completion on ATMT. These downloadable CBT elements are available anytime, anywhere, through ARCNet and ATMT, to reservists and guardsmen with internet and CAC access. Specific CBTs are available to fulfill the basic requirements of Total Force Annual Training (TFAT). Additional CBTs are available to fulfill the requirements of several Selected Force and Expeditionary Skills Training courses. Training managers can utilize ATMT's multiple options to manage unit training requirements and customize their training programs. They can assign training courses and instructors, schedule classes and create individual and/or section/unit-based profiles. Additionally, training managers can utilize ATMT to update ARCNet to reflect off-line and mass briefing participation. The ATMT reporting features allow all levels of leadership access and visibility into the unit training status. These features can be customized within the parameters available to suit a unit's needs.

PERSONNEL.title: CEI (Civilian Employment Information)-a
PERSONNEL.description: The collection of civilian employer information (CEI) facilitates open communications between the Department of Defense and the civilian employers of Guard and Reserve service members to inform service members and employers of their rights, benefits, and obligations. Yes, it's Mandatory - We know that life in the National Guard can get busy. But don't let that be the reason you don't submit your Civilian Employment Information to the Department of Defense. Based on the information you submit annually, defense officials will know whom they can call to active duty without putting civilian jobs at risk. Reporting your CEI not only influences your chances of being called to active duty, it is used to determine whether your unit or unit members should be mobilized, as well as to ensure that you aren't on active duty beyond the time the Department of Defense needs you to serve. It also provides NGB Employer Support with information that can make helping you through employment issues much easier. "What happens if I don't submit my CEI?" Again, submitting your CEI is mandatory! National Guard members who forget or refuse to submit their information (or submit false employment information) can get in trouble and be subject to administrative action or punishment (Article 92, Uniform Code of Military Justice). Moreover, if a business or public agency - like firehouses, hospitals, or police departments - must cope with multiple employees serving in the military at once, the impact on its local community could be quite great indeed. The good news is that submitting CEI is getting easier. In 10 short minutes, you can click through the entire forms process, with the added benefit of not having to think about it again for a year! PERSONNEL.title: CHRIS (Command Human Resources Intelligence System)
PERSONNEL.description: CHRIS is the AFMC Human Resource reporting tool that truly integrates civilian personnel data from the Defense Civilian Personnel Data System (DCPDS) with data from the Military Personnel Data System (MILPDS), Manpower Programming and Execution System (MPES), and the Education and Training Management System (ETMS). CHRIS provides the ability to make informed decisions concerning human resources to the AF Materiel Command, AF Space Command, National Intelligence Command, and Air National Guard. To contact the CHRIS project office, call DSN 986-1864 or Comm (937) 656-1864.

PERSONNEL.title: CMS (Case Management System)
PERSONNEL.description: Description: CMS is a case management system used for entering, tracking, resolving and reporting on pay and personnel related cases within the United States Air Force. It was developed to give base-level offices the ability to communicate with all levels of the Air Force to resolve problems with member’s computer records that cannot be resolved by directly updating the various pay or personnel systems. It also provides a tracking capability that enables all levels (Base, MAJCOM, AFPC, DFAS, and Air Staff) to perform management oversight. Finally, the embedded reporting system, using a central database, can be used to monitor trends in all types of pay and personnel cases.

PERSONNEL.title: DEERS (Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System)
PERSONNEL.description: DEERS is a database that contains information for each Uniformed Service member (Active Duty, retired, or a member of a Reserve Component), US-sponsored foreign military, DoD and Uniformed Services civilians, other personnel as directed by the DoD (including the patient population serviced through the Military Health Services System), and their eligible family members. DEERS registration is required for TRICARE eligibility and enrollment. Incorrect information in the DEERS database can cause problems with TRICARE claims as well as other health care benefits, so it is critical to maintain your DEERS information.

PERSONNEL.title: EOPF (Electronic Official Personnel Folder)
PERSONNEL.description: This application allows current Air Force employees access to their electronic official personnel folder.

PERSONNEL.title: EPROM (Virtual Enlisted Promotion Release)
PERSONNEL.description: Description: EPROM allows a user to access to view promotion cycles and supplemental cycles.

PERSONNEL.title: ESGR (Employer Support of the Guard and Reserve)
PERSONNEL.description: ESGR, a Department of Defense office, was established in 1972 to promote cooperation and understanding between Reserve Component Service members and their civilian employers and to assist in the resolution of conflicts arising from an employee's military commitment. ESGR is supported by a network of more than 4,700 volunteers in 54 committees located across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Guam-CNMI (Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands), Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Volunteers, hailing from small business and industry, government, education and prior military service bring a vast wealth of experience to assist in serving employers, service members and their families. Together with Headquarters ESGR staff and a small cadre of support staff for each State Committee, volunteers work to promote and enhance employer support for military service in the Guard and Reserve.

PERSONNEL.title: GRB (Government Retirement and Benefits) / EBIS (Employee Benefits Information System) [.mil]
PERSONNEL.description: GRB Platform is a web-based application designed to provide retirement and benefits information. With this self-service tool, you can view a statement of your benefits, use retirement calculators to perform "what-if" scenarios and view informational seminars all through the internet. GRB is available to you, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. To reach GRB, you must first login to GRB Platform Link website from a Military (.Mil) or USG (.Gov) network connection. This website is not reachable from a commercial (.Com) network connection. Note: This applies only to Air Force-serviced appropriated fund civilian employees. Employees of other agencies, such as the Department of the Army, the Department of the Navy, Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) or Military Health System (Health.Mil) must contact their Human Resources Office for the correct website applicable to their organization and assistance.

PERSONNEL.title: JKO (Joint Knowledge Online)
PERSONNEL.description: JKO is the Department of Defense (DoD) unique and authoritative source for online joint training. JKO provides joint training resources including training courses, seminars, video library, and communities of interest. Training is tracked and reported so that you can manage your unique training requirements. Individuals looking for SERE training should access the JKO Learning Content Management System which does not require a JKO/AKO (Army Knowledge Online) account.

PERSONNEL.title: MICT (Management Internal Control Toolset) (.mil only)
PERSONNEL.description: MICT (Management Internal Control Toolset). MICT is an interactive application designed to assist in managing self-assessment programs. For MICT access and/or training: https://mict.cce.af.mil.

PERSONNEL.title: milConnect
PERSONNEL.description: The milConnect web application is maintained by the Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC). This application allows beneficiaries to review personal, health care, and personnel information from one reliable source, the Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System (DEERS). Currently, sponsors and eligible beneficiaries, who are age 18 or over, are able to (if applicable) perform the following functions:- Update your organization, location and office symbol.- Update contact information in DEERS - View current health care enrollments- Manage TRICARE enrollments- Locate the nearest Military ID card issuing facility- View personnel information- Transfer education benefits to eligible family members under the Post 9/11 GI Bill- View ID cards- View Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance information (except Marines and Coast Guard)- Obtain proof of insurance if currently in a TRICARE managed program- Find answers to frequently asked questions about health care eligibility and more.

PERSONNEL.title: Military OneSource
PERSONNEL.description: Military OneSource is a confidential Department of Defense-funded program providing comprehensive information on every aspect of military life at no cost to active duty, National Guard, and reserve members, and their families. Information includes, but is not limited to, deployment, reunion, relationships, grief, spouse employment and education, parenting and childhood services. It is a virtual extension to installation services.

PERSONNEL.title: Military Personnel Data System (MilPDS)
PERSONNEL.description: Military Personnel Data System (MilPDS). MilPDS is an Air Force wide, enterprise-scale military system consisting of one of the world's largest Oracle HR implementations, involving over 100 military subsystems and in excess of 500,000 business rules. MilPDS supports Air Force active duty, retired personnel, Guard and Reserve components. MilPDS is also used to initiate pay actions, maintain Air Force accountability and strength data and supports a host of interactions with other Air Force processes and systems. System fundamentals consist of segregation of duties principles, Oracle application user interface, reports, and management output products.

PERSONNEL.title: MPES (Manpower Programming and Execution System)
PERSONNEL.description: MPES is the family of applications that supports: manpower budgeting, unit manpower requirements, personnel and position management, manpower modeling, and reporting and analysis for the Active, ANG, AFR, and civilian workforce. It is the authoritative data source for all funded AF end strength and associated PPBE manpower changes. (Source: AFI 38-204, Attachment 3).

PERSONNEL.title: My Air Force Benefits
PERSONNEL.description: All Airmen (Regular Air Force, Air National Guard, and Air Force Reserve), Family Members, retirees and the general public can use this website. However, the MyAirForceBenefits calculator features are password-protected through DS Logon/CAC and limited to Airmen in the Regular Air Force (Active Component), Active Guard and Reserve (AGR), Air National Guard, U.S. Air Force Reserve, Retired Reserve/Gray Area Retiree and Family Members. PERSONNEL.title: OKTA  (Personnel Applications)
PERSONNEL.description: Description: Hosted on the .mil domain (okta.mil), Okta is a modern, cloud-native identity solution for DoD identity data categorized as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) that requires IL4-level protection. Okta for US Military is designed to support the DoD’s software modernization, cloud adoption, and Zero Trust security capabilities and partnerships by moving mission-critical, sensitive data to Okta solutions. Okta for US Military centralizes digital trust policies so both Common Access Card (CAC) and non-CAC communities can securely access mission-relevant resources across different platforms and devices. The solution also enables DoD mission owners to leverage secure, audited identity and access management for their on-premises, web-based, and modern cloud-native apps.

PERSONNEL.title: Palace Chase - Early Separation Provision
PERSONNEL.description: The PALACE CHASE program is a voluntary early release program which allows Regular Air Force officers and enlisted members to request to transfer from active military service to an Air Reserve Component (ARC) by extending their service obligation. ARC refers to the Air National Guard of the United States (ANGUS) and the United States Air Force Reserve (USAFR).

PERSONNEL.title: Palace Front - Seamless transition to the Air Reserve Component
PERSONNEL.description: The PALACE FRONT program is an intra-service transfer program which allows active Air Force officers and enlisted members to transfer from the active component of the United States Air Force (USAF) to the Air National Guard (ANG) or the Air Force Reserve (AFR) the day after their approved Date of Separation (DOS) from the Active Duty Air Force. The PALACE FRONT program is not a voluntary separation program that will waive a current enlistment contract or active duty service commitment. The purpose of the program is to allow Airmen that already have an approved DOS to seamlessly transfer from active service to selected reserve service within the Air Reserve Component (ARC).

PERSONNEL.title: PARIS (Personnel Automated Records Information System)
PERSONNEL.description: Provides USAF Human Resource specialist access to civilian personnel electronic records.

PERSONNEL.title: PCSM (Pilot Candidate Selection Method)
PERSONNEL.description: The Pilot Candidate Selection Method (PCSM) is a tool used to predict the ability of a prospective pilot candidate to complete the first portion of Undergraduate Pilot Training (UPT). PCSM takes into account several measurements associated with success at UPT and combines them into one measurement. - Previous flying hours(Experience) - AFOQT Pilot Score(Knowledge) - Test of Basic Aviation Skills (TBAS) Scores(Aptitude) The score is on a scale of 1-99, with 99 being the best. The PCSM score is not an all-inclusive pilot selection tool; it is one part of the entire board selection process.

PERSONNEL.title: PERSTEMPO
PERSONNEL.description: PERSTEMPO is one aspect of OPTEMPO (Operation Tempo). OPTEMPO measures a weapon system's or unit's activity level, deployed or at home station, while PERSTEMPO measures an individual's temporary duty away from home station.. AF defines PERSTEMPO as days per year an individual is TDY from home station -- Day away is a day away" A day away includes all TDYs regardless of reason or duration..

PERSONNEL.title: RAW (Retrieval Application Websites)
PERSONNEL.description: This web site serves as a single point of entry for several military personnel applications; open to all USAF military, DAF civilians and USAF Contractors who have a Military or Civilian sponsor. Raw provides accurate personnel demographic data for Active Duty Air Force, Air National Guard, Civilian employees and soon Air Force Reserve, through the Interactive Demographic Analysis System (IDEAS) module. Sensitive demographic data available only thru this secure web site include: age, ethnic group, handicap, Hispanic Latino designation, race, race/ethnicity, and religious preference. It also includes a module called the PAS Code Hierarchy Application that provides PAS Code details, chain of command relationships, and PAS Code tree structure at all levels. Another module of RAW is the Retention Status Report that provides enlisted retention data to Career Assistance Advisors. There are other applications but they require special permission to gain access to them.

PERSONNEL.description: The Senior Level Career Management System (SLCMS) provides to General, Colonel, Chief and other personnel management groups a one stop center to manage senior leaders' careers, assignments, promotions, and retirements. SLCMS works best with Microsoft Edge and Chrome.

PERSONNEL.title: VMET (Verification of Military Experience and Training)
PERSONNEL.description: The DoD Transition Assistance Program (DoDTAP) for Service Members and Veterans web site is designed to provide separating Service members and Veterans access to their VMET (Verification of Military Experience and Training) documents and other Transition Assistance information which will assist them during their transition process from the military. After the Service member's completion of the required Transition Sessions and after their specific supporting Transition Assistance Office has electronically submitted a Service member's paperwork, the Service member or Veteran can access their completed transition modules & tracks, Preseparation Counseling Checklist (DD2648/-1), or Individual Transition Plan (ITP) Checklist (DD2958) from the Transition GPS web site. Any Service member or veteran with past or present Army, Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps service in either Active Duty, Reserve or Guard status is authorized to access the web site. A CAC or DS Logon Account is required to access the web site.

PERSONNEL.title: vMPF (Virtual Military Personnel Flight)
PERSONNEL.description: The Virtual Military Personnel Flight (vMPF) is a suite of applications that gives users the capability to initiate self-service applications and view their individual record and submit request to Air Force Personnel Center.

PERSONNEL.title: VOP (Virtual Out Processing)

PERSONNEL.description: Virtual Personnel Services Center Role Based Access (vPSC RBA): Role Based Access (RBA) describes the access and administration of roles for the various virtual Personnel Services Center (vPSC) applications, e.g. the Airmen Development Plan (ADP) and the Personnel Records Display Application (PRDA).

PERSONNEL.title: VRS (Volunteer Reserve System) [.mil only]
PERSONNEL.description: The Volunteer Reserve System (VRS) is provided as a service to DoD organizations with short-term, funded assignment vacancies. The intent is to advertise short-term, funded vacancies and allow Air Reserve Component (ARC) members a method of volunteering for these assignments. VRS is maintained by the ARCNet Team at Headquarters Air Force Reserve Command (HQ AFRC/SCXP). Use of VRS is voluntary, the assignments contained herein may not reflect all current needs. It is the responsibility of the agencies adding assignment vacancies to ensure information is accurate and up to date. Volunteers should address requests for more volunteer information to the agency or requisition manager associated with the assignment vacancy. Most importantly, the volunteer must ensure all approval steps of the volunteer process are accomplished before approval of assignment. Direct any concerns to the ARCNet Helpdesk at ARCNet@us.af.mil, DSN 497-2387, or 1-800-223-1784.

PUBLIC AFFAIRS.description: AFPIMS is a content management system designed to unify all Air Force public sites by giving them a uniform appearance, standardizing the paths to information and ensuring that only appropriate information is published.

PUBLIC AFFAIRS.title: Air Force Art Collection
PUBLIC AFFAIRS.description: The United States Air Force Art Collection documents the story of the Air Force through the universal language of art. The actions and deeds of Air Force men and women are recorded in paintings by eminent American artists in a way words alone could never tell. These paintings are both historical and educational and expose the military and the public to the role and diverse capabilities of the United States Air Force. The Art Collection application provides access to a database of Air Force art, along with resources for obtaining artwork for display, office placement, and submission to the collection.

SAFETY.title: ASAP (Airman Safety Action Program)
SAFETY.description: The Aviation/Airman Safety Action Program (ASAP) is a program designed to enhance aviation safety through the prevention of accidents and incidents. It is an identity protected, self-reporting system that encourages the voluntary reporting of operations and logistics/maintenance safety issues and events. It is designed to provide a non-punitive environment for the open reporting of safety concerns and information that might be critical to identifying precursors to accidents. The goal is to prevent mishaps by addressing those unintentional errors, hazardous situations and events, or high-risk activities not identified and/or correctable by other methods or through traditional safety reporting sources. The reported information is used to reduce mishaps through operational, logistics/maintenance, training and procedural enhancements. Due to its capability of providing early identification of needed safety improvements, ASAP offers significant potential for avoiding mishaps. What's needed is your input. Access ASAP to review the Status Scoreboard or submit a report.

SAFETY.title: TRiPS (Travel Risk Planning System)
SAFETY.description: Air Force Safety Center, Travel Risk Planning System (TRiPS) TRiPS is an on-line, automated driving risk-assessment tool, hosted by the Army Combat Readiness Center for the Air Force. You use it before going on leave especially when driving outside command travel limits. The system helps you and your supervisor recognize, and avoid, common hazards everyone faces on the highway: fatigue, not buckling up, speed, and distractions. A typical TRiPS session takes less than 10 minutes. You input information about your travel plans and driving habits and TRiPS presents your overall risk assessment, a map of your route, links to state highway information and weather conditions, examples of mishaps, and offers you and your supervisor suggestions to reduce that risk. To contact the helpdesk, simple hit the "contact" link at the bottom of the TRiPS homepage or email: AFSCSEG@us.af.mil.

Discover what credentialing is, how AF COOL works and how to apply.

TRAINING.title: Air Force Logistics Professional Development Program (AF LPDP)
TRAINING.description: AF LPDP is a voluntary professional certificate program designed for, and focused on, AF civilian personnel who are, or who have been, in the logistics career field. However, military logistics personnel may participate in the program if they meet all of the established requirements. AF LPDP is an overarching program that consists of professional development certificates for the four logistics workforce categories: Supply Management, Maintenance Support, Deployment/Distribution/Transportation, and Life Cycle Logistics. AF LPDP implements AFMAN36-606, Civilian Career Field Management and Development, and is Codified in Air Force Logistics Professional Development Program (AF LPDP) Special Program Guidance

TRAINING.title: CJIC (Criminal Justice Information Cell)
TRAINING.description: The site is a platform to promote awareness and training about the Air Force’s roles and responsibilities for administrative and criminal indexing. The site is managed by the Department of the Air Force – Criminal Justice Information Cell (DAF-CJIC).

TRAINING.title: DAF e-Learning (DAFeL)
TRAINING.description: DAF e-Learning (DAFeL) provides customizable learning solutions curated in coordination with DAF personnel, industry leading vendors including MIT Sloan, and Skillsoft SMEs designed upskill and reskill in business, leadership, and tech skills; advance careers; complete upgrade training; and prepare for and maintain professional certifications

TRAINING.title: Department of the Air Force Learning Record (DAFLR)
TRAINING.description: It is a “one stop shop” consolidating learning data for the Total Force, enabling individuals and units to view learning information in one location. The DAFLR provides an Individual Learning Record consolidating and displaying a comprehensive record of an Airmen and Guardian’s training, education, and experiential accomplishments throughout a learner’s career and in one location; a validated record of what an individual knows and can do. Individuals no longer need to expend additional time and energy navigating through multiple systems to identify and track their knowledge and skills gaps for self-development. The DAFLR also provides Unit Metrics aggregating and displaying unit learning accomplishments. This arms leaders at every level with the ability to evaluate learning achievements and skills gaps in seconds, informing and expediting Force development decisions at the individual, unit, and service levels. If you are having issues please contact: AETC.FD.DAFLR@us.af.mil

It also contains courses conducted/administered by AF and Reserve forces. This site is accessible by anyone with a CAC, and enabled AFNET account, located at a .mil or .gov site. TRAINING.title: JLLIS (Joint Lessons Learned Information System)
TRAINING.description: Joint Lessons Learned Information System (JLLIS) is the automated solution supporting implementation of the Chairman's Joint Lessons Learned Program (JLLP). JLLIS facilitates the collection, tracking, management, sharing, collaborative resolution and dissemination of lessons learned to improve the development/readiness of the Joint Force. The validated information also enables actionable Doctrine, Organization, Training, Materiel, Leadership and Education, Personnel, and Facilities (DOTMLPF) and Policy changes to improve joint and combined capabilities.

TRAINING.description: MyETMS is a subsystem of the AFMC Education and Training Management System (ETMS Web) and is a personal training management system for all AFMC Civilian and Military members. It allows AFMC Airmen to be actively involved in their professional and personal development.

TRAINING.title: myLearning
TRAINING.description: myLearning replaces HQ AETC's Advanced Distributed Learning System (ADLS) for various course access. myLearning supports the AF goal of providing web-based training that offers all Airmen the flexibility to accomplish training anytime, anywhere, —24/7. From any browser, students can complete lesson materials, take quizzes, and interact with instructors by e-mail. Highlighted courses include, but not limited to: Cyber Awareness Challenge, Force Protection, and Suicide Prevention Annual Training, which satisfy annual training requirements Service Desk: FAQs and User Guides: https://usaf.dps.mil/teams/aetc/aasdfaq Email: AETC.SCOH.ASDHelpdesk@us.af.mil

TRAINING.title: MyVector
TRAINING.description: MyVECTOR is an enterprise solution that supports the Air Force's goal to provide a standardized process available to all Airmen for career development and mentoring. Airmen can be proactive about their career development and mentoring relationships. It's also a mechanism for the Career Field Management (CFM) teams to communicate specific job information to their members by providing job descriptions, typical job duration estimates, and typical follow-on job recommendations from each of the job "buckets" defined on their members' pyramids. Through the combination of an Airman's specific duty history information and the CFM team-defined general recommendations, MyVector provides Airmen the ability to fully develop a career plan. The My Mentoring feature completes the system view of the whole picture.
